rationale: Two-corpus gate wave 2026-09 (cats-effect). ScalaD-A: implementing an ABSTRACT member needs no `override` keyword in Scala (required only for CONCRETE base members) — keywordless ImplA.value/ImplB.value are genuine overrides of BaseTrait.value, resolved signature-exact through intermediate abstract classes. ScalaD-B: a keyworded override must resolve to the TRUE declaring ancestor (ImplB.doubled -> BaseTrait.doubled), never a first-supertype guess against Mid (which does not declare doubled). ScalaD-C: `private[scope]` is package-visible and overridable, not a hard private. Overloads with different parameter lists never pair.
